Guides to the area

Getting to El Bedorc from Barcelona without a car

Take the FGC R6 train from Plaça Espanya to Piera (about 66 minutes), then Piera's P5 town bus to El Bedorc (about 12 minutes). At weekends there is a train every hour and the P5 runs six times a day.

Updated 9 November 2026

El Bedorc is a hamlet that belongs to Piera. Without a car you get there in two legs: the train to Piera station and the town bus to the village.

The train: R6 from Plaça Espanya to Piera

It is the Llobregat-Anoia line of Ferrocarrils de la Generalitat (FGC), the one that runs to Igualada. According to the timetables FGC publishes for this November:

  • Weekdays: about 30 departures from Plaça Espanya towards Piera, from 5.32 am to 10 pm, taking between 62 and 76 minutes.
  • Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays: one train an hour, at 09 past (from 6.09 am to 9.09 pm), plus a last one at 10 pm. The ride takes 66 minutes.
  • Coming back at weekends: trains leave Piera at 17 past the hour and reach Plaça Espanya 66 minutes later.

The bus: P5 from the station to El Bedorc

All of Piera's town bus lines start and end at the FGC station, and tickets are part of the ATM fare system. The town council subsidises the single ticket to 1.20 €. The buses are run by Montferri.

At weekends the line that goes through El Bedorc is the P5. It leaves Piera-FGC and reaches the Bedorc stop in about 10 to 12 minutes:

  • Saturdays: 8.35, 10.20 am, 4.00, 5.36, 7.40 and 9.20 pm.
  • Sundays and public holidays: 9.36, 11.26 am, 4.00, 5.41, 7.40 and 9.20 pm.

On the way back, the same bus passes El Bedorc 12 to 20 minutes after leaving and gets to the station in time for the Barcelona train. On weekdays there are fewer buses, spread across lines P5, P9 and P90 at irregular times: check the weekday timetable.

These bus times are the current ones published by Montferri (updated in July 2025). Check them on its website or app before you travel.

A sample weekend

  • Saturday: the 4.09 pm train from Plaça Espanya, in Piera at 5.15; the 5.36 pm P5 bus, in El Bedorc at 5.48. Check-in at the house is from 3 pm.
  • Sunday: check-out is by 11 am. The P5 passes El Bedorc at 11.38 and reaches the station at 11.53; the 12.17 train gets to Plaça Espanya at 1.23 pm.

If you are unsure about the stop or your arrival time, tell us when you book.
